title: Schedule
intro: The event's programme: talks, tournaments, meals and quiet hours. Attendees see it with a countdown on the public schedule page and big screens.
importHint: Import an iCal file (.ics) from a calendar or the event website. Importing again updates what the last import brought in; items added here stay.
eventHelp: The public page counts down to the start and thanks everyone after the end.
publicOff: The public schedule page is off. An admin turns it on in Settings > Attendee pages.
empty: Nothing planned yet. Add an item or import an iCal file.
